candidats.description: Manual metal arc welding steel connections on deck

The New Linz Danube Bridge (project name) is the replacement of the railway bridge dismantled in 2016. It was built according to a design by the Paris architecture firm Mimram. The connection between the steel structure and the concrete road surface is accomplished by welded-on bolts .
